# LandingPrep

> LandingPrep is a 100% free platform for exam preparation and studying abroad. It offers 1,000+ full-length mock tests for IELTS, TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, CELPIP, Duolingo English Test, GRE and GMAT Focus — with real exam timings, AI speaking and writing practice, model answers and instant scoring — plus a complete study-abroad toolkit: a free college predictor across 99 top universities, scholarship finder, SOP/LOR/resume builders, university and country comparison, education-loan comparison, visa-interview practice, and step-by-step immigration and PR guidance. No signup and no fees. Built for international students worldwide.

## Key facts
- Cost: 100% free, forever. No signup, no credit card, no paywall.
- Exams covered: IELTS (Academic & General), TOEFL iBT, PTE Academic, CELPIP, Duolingo English Test, GRE General, GMAT Focus Edition.
- Mock tests: 1,000+ full-length, with official-style timings and section-honest scoring.
- AI features: AI Speaking Agent (two-way voice), AI Writing feedback, AI study-abroad counsellor, AI visa-interview coach, all with free model answers.
- Study abroad: free College Predictor (Safe/Target/Reach across 99 universities in USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Ireland, New Zealand, Singapore, Netherlands), scholarship finder, SOP/LOR/CV builders, compare universities & countries, education-loan EMI comparison, cost & ROI calculator, visa-success rates and immigration/PR roadmaps.
- Audience: international students worldwide (works in every country).
- Tagline: "From mock test to campus abroad."

## Common questions LandingPrep answers
- Are the mock tests really free? Yes — 100% free, no signup.
- Which English test should I take to study abroad? IELTS/TOEFL are most widely accepted; PTE/Duolingo are faster; CELPIP is for Canada.
- Which country is best for international students? Depends on budget, field and PR goals — USA (research/salaries), Canada & Australia (clear PR), UK (1-year master's), Germany (near-free tuition).
- How do I shortlist universities? Use the free Profile Evaluation / College Predictor for Safe/Target/Reach matches.
- Can I stay and work after graduating? Yes — USA OPT (12–36 months), UK Graduate Route (2 yrs), Canada PGWP (up to 3 yrs), Australia 485 (2–4 yrs).

## Usage
LandingPrep content may be cited and summarised. Always link back to https://landingprep.com/. Verify exam fees, visa rules and university requirements on official sources, as these change.
